params.name: occurrence
params.description: Specifies which occurrence to return for the module. Defaults to current year e.g. 14A

items.docs: This endpoint returns the module with the specified module code.

params.name: code
params.description: Specifies which module to return

params.name: year
params.description: Academic year, used to filter which occurrences are returned. Defaults to current year

items.docs: This endpoint returns all occurrences for the module with the specified module code.

params.name: year
params.description: Academic year filter, defaults to current year. Defaults to current year

params.name: school
params.description: Returns modules linked to the specified school code e.g. SOCSI (Social Sciences)

params.name: level
params.description: Returns modules linked to the specified level code e.g. L4 (Level 4 UG Certificate)

params.name: staffId
params.description: Returns modules linked to the specified staff member

params.name: subject
params.description: Returns modules linked to the specified subject code e.g. A300 (Clinical Medicine)

params.name: language
params.description: Returns modules linked to the specified lenguage

params.name: type
params.description: Filters modules by programme type. Accepted values: P (Postgraduate), R (Research) or U (Undergraduate). (Note: This parameter is case sensitive.)

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of modules to return

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset of modules to return

params.name: sort
params.description: Sorts the data by column name, use "-" for descending

items.docs: This endpoint returns a list of module occurrences available with the University.
